text:
Hi everyone! I’m married to an Israeli citizen and we are currently living in my home country in Europe (we’ve been here since November 2025). We are planning to return to Israel very soon because my spouse has a great business partnership offer there.
The Situation:
I previously had a work visa in Israel but canceled my A5 interview when we moved away. At the time, Misrad HaPnim told me I couldn't re-open my file until November 2026.
My Questions:
1. Early Re-opening: Since we are moving back permanently for work now, has anyone successfully appealed a "waiting period" like this to start the process early?
2. The Checklist: If we have to wait until November, what should I be doing right now while I'm still in my home country? What documents are a "must" for a returning couple who previously closed their file?
Would love to hear from anyone who has successfully "re-started" their process. Thanks! :)
